title: Web Lead
summary: I managed and developed Flash based websites for the company's brand sites. Over a half dozen sites were all managed from Intranet applications I initiated, including content management, catalog management, rider biographies, race results, and dealer locater. Visits for www.mooseracing.com tripled over a 3-4 month period and page hits tripled for www.thormx.com after I updated these sites. I also managed and developed the company e-commerce site redesign (www.partsnetweb.com), which handled transactions totaling hundreds of millions annually.
